description: Group-aware learning curves: train LinearSVC on increasing fractions of training groups (0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0), three random samples each, evaluated on fixed validation partition. Compares word TF-IDF vs MiniLM embeddings.
key_finding: Word TF-IDF reaches ~0.820 macro F1 at full training (13,439 rows). Embedding curve plateaus lower (~0.719). More data helps word model; embedding model is data-limited.
